description: This PHP source file sets up and tests an interface for issue tracking integration with Jira via REST API, including configuration setup, connection testing, and issue creation methods.

classes.name: jirarestInterface
classes.description: A class for interfacing with Jira's REST API for issue management.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the interface can successfully connect to Jira.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Retrieves the API client instance used to communicate with Jira.

methods.description: Adds an issue to Jira via the REST API.
